title: Projective dimension bounded by Tor dimension for finite Noetherian modules
statement: Let R be a Noetherian commutative ring and M a finite R-module. Let d be a natural number. If Tor_i^R(M,N)=0 for every R-module N and every i>d [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules], then HasProjectiveDimensionLE M d, equivalently Ext_R^i(M,N)=0 for all R-modules N and i≥d+1 [def-pc-ext, def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension].

source.place: Tags 00M5, 058R and the resolution-splicing argument of 00S2; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/058R

proof.text: Induct on d. For d=0 apply the flat Tor ideal criterion to every ideal quotient. The module is finitely presented by Noetherianity, hence flatness makes it projective (Mathlib Module.Flat.projective_of_finitePresentation).

For d+1 choose a finite free presentation of M. Its kernel is finite by Noetherianity. The free-presentation dimension-shift isomorphism transports the Tor bound to d for this kernel. Apply induction, and then the short-exact projective-dimension equivalence of Mathlib to recover bound d+1.

theorem finite_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_tor_bound
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Finite R M] (d : ℕ)
    (hTor : ∀ N : ModuleCat.{u} R, ∀ i : ℕ, d < i →
      IsZero (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj M).obj N)) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE M d
